description:
Inventory from T-013's bisect: the App suite is 51 files, 37 green. No segfaults remain (that was AsHydratable's getFillable recursion, fixed in T-013). Work the rest in batches with a fixed file list per batch.

Batch A - fatal, no summary printed (exit 2 with zero test output; a fatal error rather than assertion failures): ActionTest, ActionsTest, AsAuthenticatedTest.

Batch B - assertion/API drift, all tests in the file failing: AsLifecycleTest (4), AsLoggerTest (4), AsPermissionTest (4), TracerDecoratorTest (6), PasswordConfirmationActionTest (15 of 16), AuthorizeWithRouteParametersTest (1).

Batch C - partial failures, most of the file passing: AsCircuitBreakerTest (1 of 4), AsLockTest (2 of 5), AsMetricsTest (4 of 5), AsPipelineTest (4 of 5), AsRetryTest (3 of 4), AsStatefulTest (3 of 4), AsThrottleTest (1 of 4), AsTransactionTest (1 of 3).

Skipped rather than failing, no action needed: AsAuditableTest (4, "Audits table does not exist"), AsTimeoutTest (2), AsCacheTest (1).

Run one file with: vendor/bin/pest --testsuite=App --no-tia --filter=<name-without-Test>
title: App suite behaviour and API drift batches
